acs.text:
Given the text `# Guide

## Contents {: .no-toc }

[TOC]

## Install

## Usage` and extensions `toc` and `attr_list`, when it is converted, then the output contains `href="#guide"`, `href="#install"` and `href="#usage"` and contains no `href="#contents"`.
Given the same text, when it is converted, then `md.toc` contains no `>Contents<`.
Given the text from AC-FR-001-1 with `toc` and `attr_list`, when it is converted, then the output contains `Contents`.
Given the text `## Contents {: .no-toc }\n\n## Contents {: .no-toc }` with `toc` and `attr_list`, when it is converted, then the output contains `id="contents"` and `id="contents_1"`.

Given the text from AC-FR-001-1 with `toc` and `attr_list`, when it is converted, then `md.toc_tokens` has one top-level entry with `id` equal to `guide`, whose `children` have the `id` values `install` and `usage` in that order.
Given the same conversion, when `md.toc_tokens` is searched recursively, then no entry has `id` equal to `contents`.
